messages.author: e19ea506112fd25b
messages.subject: vectorized vs. unvectorized
parts:
Hi,

I found very interesting (but not pleasant) behavior in Win 10 rstan: on some PCs vectorized model kills R while on other PCs the same code don't. Both versions of the code are attached (n at the end of file name indicates unvectorized version). 8schools example runs fine on both PCs - the code is unvectorized what gave me a clue that I should unvectorize the code to remove unpleasant behavior. It would be great to find the reason since my feeling is that vectorized code is more efficient - or maybe I am vectorizing it too much...

Thank you,
Linas

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] vectorized vs. unvectorized
parts:
What was the behavior?

The 8schools code you sent *is* vectorized in
the densities. Although 8schools is trivial due
to size, in general

eta ~ normal(0, 1);

is more efficient than

target += normal_lpdf(eta | 0, 1);

because it'll drop the constant terms.

The vectorized probability functions are more
efficient because they can share computations and require
fewer virtual function calls for derivative propagation.

- Bob

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] vectorized vs. unvectorized
parts:
Bob,

Thanks you. I will update the model appropriately.

Initially I had 8schhols, and both vectorized models in my R code. 8schools went through but dialog box popped "R GUI encountered a problem" during the first fit. It happened 3-5 times in a row. Then I realized that vectorization might be a problem and unvectorized one of the models while leaving the other one vectorized. This time R went trhrough 8schools and the unvectorized model but dialog box popped out on the vectorized model.

On Windows, when this dialog box pops out, you can't do anything, just exit R.

Please note that this didn't occur on another PC.

Bob,

I think I found the problem. Since I am using network drive I have
created rda on one PC and then accidentally used this rda on another
machine. It means that culprit is not vectorization but reusing rda file
created on a different PC. Both are Win 10 but different models of Dell.
I have R 3.2.5, rstan 2.11.1, and Rtools 3.3.0.1959. On good PC I have
the same combo.

Linas
